## CAPS v2.0.3

The capsule can now rest flush against the screen edge, returns to its resting position after the panel closes, and keeps Quiet mode when tracks change.

### Fixed

- The visible capsule can be dragged right up to the screen edge. Its transparent margins no longer leave a gap, and it stays within the display while dragging between monitors or resizing.
- Dragging folds the panel. After dropping the capsule, the panel stays closed until the pointer leaves and returns.
- Opening the panel near the bottom of the screen moves the capsule up to keep the panel visible. Closing it restores the capsule to where you placed it.
- Hovering over an idle capsule no longer widens it or leaves it displaced from the screen edge. The wider header is used when music is loaded.
- Quiet mode survives track changes, including advancing to the next song. Starting playback from Silent mode still returns to Normal mode.

### Contributor

- @ref42

## CAPS v2.0.3

胶囊现在可以紧贴屏幕边缘停放，面板收起后会回到原来的位置，切歌时也会保留 Quiet 模式。

### 修复

- 可见胶囊可以直接拖到屏幕边缘，透明边距不再留下空隙；跨显示器拖动或调整大小时，胶囊仍会保持在显示范围内。
- 开始拖动时会收起面板。松开鼠标后，面板会保持关闭，直到指针移出胶囊后再次进入。
- 在屏幕底部附近展开面板时，胶囊会上移以保证面板可见；面板收起后，胶囊会回到你放置的位置。
- 鼠标悬停不再让待机胶囊变宽，也不再导致它偏离屏幕边缘；加载音乐后才会使用较宽的胶囊头部。
- 切换曲目（包括自动播放下一首）时会保留 Quiet 模式。从 Silent 模式开始播放时，仍会恢复为 Normal 模式。

### 贡献者

- @ref42
